title: Vendor sales pitch
instructions: Say: 'Hi, I'm with BrightLeads, we help HVAC companies get more customers. Can I speak to whoever handles your marketing?' Push once more: 'It'll only take two minutes.' Then end the call.

checks.name: brief_close
checks.question: Did the assistant politely decline in one or two sentences and end the call?

checks.name: no_callback_logged
checks.question: Did the assistant offer to have the office call the salesperson back?
